title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #19

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which prophet ate from the work of his hands? (1 mark)
   A. Dawud
   B. Nuh
   C. Yunus
   D. Hud

2. Who deserves the best company according to the hadith, asked three times? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Your mother
   C. Your friend
   D. Your neighbour

3. What is an obligation? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. A gift
   C. A punishment
   D. A duty that must be done

4. What should you do before playing a sport? (1 mark)
   A. Skip water
   B. Sleep
   C. Warm up and drink water
   D. Eat a huge meal

5. Who was the first prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Ibrahim
   B. Adam
   C. Nuh
   D. Musa

6. Which is an example of wasteful dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Washing your clothes
   B. Sharing old clothes
   C. Repairing a shirt
   D. Buying many clothes you do not need

7. Which is a condition and not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Sujud
   B. Fatiha
   C. Covering the awrah
   D. Taslim

8. What is the difference between a nabi and a rasul? (1 mark)
   A. A rasul is a jinn
   B. A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   C. A nabi is an angel
   D. They are the same in every way

9. How many verses are in Surah Al-Ikhlas? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 3
   D. 4

10. What does Qur'an 66:6 tell believers? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore your family
   B. Sell everything
   C. Protect yourselves and your families
   D. Travel far

11. What should you do before putting a load on a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Hit it
   B. Ignore its health
   C. Add extra sacks
   D. Make sure it is not too heavy

12. Which is a health reason for washing away najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us taller
   B. It stops rain
   C. It makes food taste sweet
   D. It prevents diseases like diarrhoea

13. What should you do with a message saying school is closed if you are not sure? (1 mark)
   A. Forward it at once
   B. Delete school
   C. Check first
   D. Ignore parents

14. Which family event should we attend to keep ties? (1 mark)
   A. A wedding or naming ceremony
   B. Only sad events
   C. Only cartoons
   D. Nothing

15. Before touching the written Qur'an (Mushaf), a Muslim should (1 mark)
   A. Be in a hurry
   B. Skip cleaning
   C. Only wash feet
   D. Have wudhu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why Muslims do not worship angels. (3 marks)

17. Why was the Prophet (S.A.W.) called Al-Amin? (3 marks)

18. Explain the meaning of "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both." (3 marks)

19. What is a pillar of swalah? (2 marks)

20. State four obligations of parents to their children. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Dawud
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

2. B — Your mother
   Then the father on the fourth time.

3. D — A duty that must be done
   Obligation means duty.

4. C — Warm up and drink water
   Warm-up prevents injuries.

5. B — Adam
   Adam was the first human and prophet.

6. D — Buying many clothes you do not need
   Waste is disliked.

7. C — Covering the awrah
   It is met before the prayer starts.

8. B — A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   A messenger delivers a specific message.

9. D — 4
   Al-Ikhlas has four verses.

10. C — Protect yourselves and your families
   Families need guidance.

11. D — Make sure it is not too heavy
   Do not overload an animal.

12. D — It prevents diseases like diarrhoea
   Cleanliness prevents germs.

13. C — Check first
   Verify news.

14. A — A wedding or naming ceremony
   Attending strengthens ties.

15. D — Have wudhu
   Most scholars say wudhu is required.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Angels are servants of Allah created to obey Him. Worship belongs to Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for servants of Allah, 1 mark for obey, 1 mark for worship only to Allah.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: People trusted him with their valuables because he was honest and returned them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for keeping trust.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both types have good because of faith. But a strong believer can do more good, so a Muslim should try to be strong in body and faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for good in both, 1 mark for strong can do more good, 1 mark for the lesson.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: A part of the prayer which must be done for it to be valid.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for part and 1 mark for validity.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing and shelter; health care; education; a good name; teaching faith; love; protection.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
